summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of its annual general meeting of shareholders scheduled for June 16, 2026. Proposals include re-election of directors, amendment to articles of association to increase authorized ordinary shares, approval of CEO employment agreement amendments, RSU grants to CEO and chairman, reappointment of auditors, and review of financial statements. This is a routine annual meeting notification with no special-situation event.
